correctness.rationale: Under unnormalized planar area and t>−1, ||z^n||²=2π B(2n+2,t+1); angular Parseval establishes complete orthogonal monomials. Their reciprocal moments yield K_t(s)=(t+1)[(1−x)^−a−(1+x)^−a]/(4πx), a=t+2>1 and x²=s, with K_t(0)=(t+1)(t+2)/(2π). For |x|<1, the Cayley q=(1+x)/(1−x) lies in Re q>0 so |Im Log q|<π/2; the zero equation a Log q=2πik demands 0<|k|<a/4. Inverting yields x=i tan(πk/a), s=−tan²(πk/a); ±k denote one scalar root. Differentiating the odd numerator gives F′=2ac/(1−x²)≠0 at every nonzero zero, establishing simplicity and completeness. Strict j<a/4 excludes s=−1 at t=4j−2 and yields N(t)=ceil((t+2)/4)−1; zero-free iff t≤2 within t>−1. No branch ambiguity or fixed-section/root-count conflation.
